objections: Faithful: the explanation says that in Genesis 1 God "gives them" "the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth". shown.differs: Jeremiah adds "for I am only a child" and is told "Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you" (Jer 1:6, 8); Moses adds "I have never been eloquent" and is told "I will help you as you speak" (Exod 4:10, 12). Jeremiah is told the LORD has already put His words in his mouth, while Moses is told what the LORD will teach him to say.
